fees.notes: IMU College (IMC), which delivers the programme, publishes a total 3-year fee of RM63,250 (includes registration, tuition, accommodation, uniforms and clinical-posting transport). IMC does not publish a separate international rate, so this single published programme fee is used; per_year = 63,250 / 3 (derived). Sources: https://www.imc.edu.my/diploma-in-nursing/, https://www.imu.edu.my/programmes/diploma-in-nursing/ (accessed 2026-09-18).
